input.task: What is the title of the story on this Hacker News item page?

provenance: second live domain (M6 live breadth). Item 1 is HN's first-ever story (Oct 9, 2006): title, submitter and URL are as frozen as the public web gets. Ground truth hand-verified 2026-08-17 with an eval-side Playwright probe: get_by_role('link') on the page yields the 10-link site header first, then [10] sitebit favicon, [11] 'Y Combinator' (the title), [12] 'ycombinator.com', [13] 'pg'. The anchor is the submitter 'pg', not the title itself — anchoring on the string the case asks for would let the extraction satisfy its own identity check. One page load per run, no crawling.

triage.index_11_is_brittle: HN's table markup exposes no headings, so the title is reachable only positionally — index 11 holds only while the site header keeps exactly 10 links. Same declared limitation as live-books-travel-price's index 5: live extraction is positional until `near:` exists in the resolver. If HN adds a header link, this goes red loudly, which is the correct failure mode.
